main_text.p: vehementissimum in Deum, Ec-clesiam, rempub. & vestros popu-lareis amantissimumque studium equidem non potui quin publica ce-lebratione mea coram hoc Sole... apud omneis insuper praedicarem, & tenui accessione opella mea pro-pensissimum meum erga V. A. ani-mum testatum facerem, omnia mea officia deferens ultro & spon-dens in Domino.

V. A. demisse oro hoc meum pusillum munusculum in bonam partem dignentur accipere: quod Deo sit gloria, omnibus aedificatio-ni, & V. A. ornamento. Deum vero optimum maximum & Pa-trem Domini nostri Iesu Christi supplex oro quam religiosissime,

page.notes: Catchword "Illu-" at the foot right is a line-end catchword, kept as the last word. Some words are in a slightly blurred print; "Sole" with a long-tailed mark after it is transcribed as printed. Stray marks at the right edge (a "3" and fragments) are show-through or edge marks, not transcribed. Sentence "Sole" continues in the printed "Sole-" form with a connector mark, left as printed.
